subject: math
topicName: Trigonometry - Lesson 1: From Right to Oblique Triangles
description: Distinguish right and oblique triangles, then identify common triangle-solving given cases such as ASA, AAS, SSA, SAS, and SSS.
learningObjectives: Distinguish right triangles from oblique triangles using angle information
Describe why right-triangle trigonometry does not directly fit non-right triangles
Identify given information in a triangle diagram or word description
Classify triangle-solving cases as ASA, AAS, SSA, SAS, or SSS
Explain whether a triangle situation begins with right-triangle tools, Law of Sines thinking, or Law of Cosines thinking
prerequisites: Right angle, acute angle, and obtuse angle vocabulary
Basic triangle notation for vertices, sides, and angles
Familiarity with sine, cosine, and tangent in right triangles
